description: The bar chart, titled "What Does Neuro Mean to Cardio Investigating the Role of Clinical Specialty Data in Medical LLMs," illustrates the negative log probability for various medical specialties when used as per-specialty terms. The x-axis lists the specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The y-axis represents the negative log probability, ranging from -22 to -27. Each specialty has a group of bars, with the light blue bar labeled "Mistralv0.2-Base" representing the baseline model. The other bars, colored in shades of orange and brown, represent different clinical specialties. The chart shows that the negative log probability for the "Mistralv0.2-Base" model is consistently lower (more negative) than the other specialties across all categories, indicating a higher probability of the terms being generated by the base model. The bars for the different specialties show varying levels of negative log probability, with some specialties having higher probabilities (less negative values) than others. The chart also includes a legend at the top, indicating that the light blue bar corresponds to the "Mistralv0.2-Base" model.
